app.name: PrintFlow
app.offlineHint: All data stays local on this device

common.noResultsHint: Try adjusting your search or filters.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your workshop status at a glance
dashboard.lowStockEmpty: All active spools are well stocked.
dashboard.emptyBody: Add a filament to the catalog first, then register your spools and start your first project.

catalog.title: Filament catalog
catalog.subtitle: Manage filament types and their specifications
catalog.empty: No filament in the catalog yet
catalog.emptyBody: Add a filament type — brand, material, colour and the empty spool weight.
catalog.deleteBody: All spools of this filament and their stock will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.spoolTareWeightHint: Weight of the bare spool without filament

spools.title: Spools
spools.subtitle: Stock, storage location and remaining weight
spools.emptyBody: Register your first spool to track filament consumption automatically.
spools.needsCatalogBody: Spools are based on a filament type from the catalog. Create an entry there first.
spools.deductHint: Will be subtracted from the remaining weight.
spools.deleteBody: The spool and its stock data will be removed. This cannot be undone.

tare.title: Tare calculator
tare.subtitle: Work out the net weight from a scale reading
tare.negative: The scale reading is below the empty spool weight — please check.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Plan and track multi-part assemblies
projects.emptyBody: Create a project, list the parts you need and drop your .3mf files onto it.
projects.deleteBody: The parts, print plates and print history of this project will be deleted too.

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: A short note about this project

parts.title: Bill of materials
parts.subtitle: Required, printed and failed parts
parts.emptyBody: List the individual parts of your assembly with the quantity each one needs.
parts.deleteBody: The part and its counters will be removed.

plates.title: Print plates
plates.subtitle: Read from .3mf or .gcode files
plates.emptyBody: Drop a .3mf file here to read print time and filament usage automatically.

dropzone.title: Drop a file here
dropzone.subtitle: or click to choose a file

plates.noFilamentData: No filament usage found in the file
plates.assignPartsHint: Define which project parts sit on this plate and in what quantity. They are then counted automatically after a print.
plates.deleteBody: The plate and its print history will be removed.
plates.parseWarning: The file could only be read partially. Please check the values.

job.title: Log a print
job.subtitle: Assign spools and record the outcome
job.assignSpoolsHint: Pick the spool actually used for each filament slot. Usage is deducted automatically after the print.
job.insufficientWarning: At least one slot does not have enough filament. You can continue anyway — that spool will be set to 0 g.
job.noSpoolsAvailable: No active spools available. Add a spool first.
job.markSuccessHint: Deduct filament and count printed parts
job.markFailedHint: Deduct filament and count as scrap
job.durationHint: Leave empty to use the estimated time.
job.historyEmptyBody: Once you log a print it will show up here.
job.deleteBody: The entry will be removed. Stock and counters already booked stay unchanged.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, data and backups
settings.databaseHint: Your data lives in a SQLite file on this device.
settings.exportHint: Copies the whole database to a .db file.
settings.importHint: Replaces all existing data with the backup.
settings.importConfirmBody: All current data will be replaced by the selected file. The previous database is kept alongside as a .bak file. The app reloads afterwards.
settings.aboutBody: PrintFlow runs fully offline. No data is ever sent to external servers.

errors.dbInit: The database could not be opened.

errors.notFoundBody: This entry does not exist (any more).

parse.noMetadata: No print data was found in the file. You can enter the values manually.
